'''Mac Moria''' was a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as a supply officer for fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mac Moria appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and the expansions [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']]<ref name="TOR" /> and [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], as a Rakata Gear vendor for the Bounty Hunter class. During a restructuring of the game's gear system in Game Update 2.0, he was changed to a Basic Gear vendor. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.
